visual_goal: Show facts flowing from sources into one vehicle record keyed to the car, out through the data half and the workflow half into decisions, with decisions producing new facts and a correction travelling back to every copy.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration. Far left: a stack of generic document and building icons labeled 'Sources'. One arrow from 'Sources' to a central folder with a small generic car on its cover, labeled 'One vehicle record'; the arrow is labeled 'sourced facts'. From 'One vehicle record' two arrows fan out to the right: an upper arrow into a blue box with a report and chart icon labeled 'Data half', and a lower arrow into a teal box with a dealer screen icon labeled 'Workflow half'. One arrow from 'Data half' and one arrow from 'Workflow half' both point into a green box with a checkmark labeled 'Decisions'. One long curved arrow along the bottom runs from 'Decisions' back to 'One vehicle record', labeled 'new facts'. Above the record, a small orange correction pen icon labeled 'Correction' with one orange arrow pointing down into 'One vehicle record'. These are the only labels in the image.
alt: Sources feed one vehicle record; it feeds the data half and the workflow half, both of which feed decisions; decisions return new facts to the record, and a correction arrives at the record.

visual_goal: Show how the ten parts relate: Part I as the base, the data half and workflow half exchanging facts, the shared backbone beneath both, journeys crossing both halves, leadership steering the backbone and practice testing leadership.
prompt: A layered map illustration. At the bottom, a wide flat foundation slab labeled 'Part I Market'. Standing on it, two tall blocks side by side: a blue block on the left labeled 'Parts II–III Data half' and a teal block on the right labeled 'Part IV Workflow half'. Between the two blocks, one arrow from left to right labeled 'facts' and one arrow from right to left labeled 'new facts'. Behind and beneath both blocks, a wide green platform band labeled 'Parts V–VII Backbone' supporting them both. A long orange road ribbon crosses in front of both blocks horizontally, labeled 'Part VIII Journeys'. Above the right side, a small control tower labeled 'Part IX Leadership' with one arrow down into 'Parts V–VII Backbone'. To the far right, a small magnifier-over-documents box labeled 'Part X Practice' with one arrow into 'Part IX Leadership'. These seven part labels and two arrow labels are the only words in the image.
alt: A map of the book: Part I as the foundation, Parts II–III and Part IV as two blocks exchanging facts, Parts V–VII as the shared backbone, Part VIII as a road crossing both, Part IX steering the backbone and Part X testing Part IX.
